[[File:Donovian_rainmen.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Donovian rainmen]]
A '''rainman''' was any technician who tended the signal towers above the rainy [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Donovia/Legends|Donovia]]. Easily recognized by their distinctive rain hoods, the efforts of the rainmen kept the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] traffic to and from Donovia moving smoothly. Some also worked abroad as [[Freighter tramper/Legends|freighter trampers]].
